day_shape: 88 items dominated by US-Iran Islamabad MoU signing two days early — 14-point text published, E4+ joint statement, Russia/China/Pakistan welcomes — alongside IDF reservist killed and multiple Hezbollah drone/rocket attacks in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: US-Iran Islamabad MoU signed early
threads.summary: Trump and Pezeshkian signed the 14-point Islamabad memorandum of understanding ending the US-Iran war, taking effect two days ahead of schedule, with enriched nuclear material to be diluted inside Iran under IAEA supervision. Trump said Iran would retain ballistic missiles but never nuclear weapons, and warned the MoU was 'not final' with a return to 'dropping bombs' if talks fail.

threads.label: International reaction to Iran deal
threads.summary: E4 leaders plus a broad coalition of 35+ countries issued a joint statement on the US-Iran peace deal via the UK Prime Minister's Office, while Russian and Chinese foreign ministries said they welcomed the signing. Defa Press reported Pakistan's PM Shehbaz Sharif thanked Iran's leadership and confirmed his endorsement as mediator of the Islamabad MoU.

threads.label: Israeli pushback and analysis of MoU
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post opinion pieces called the deal a 'catastrophic capitulation' resolving none of the war's goals, with Israel's Security Cabinet reportedly frustrated and ISW assessing economic relief would let Tehran reconstitute military power. US officials clarified Iran would not receive funds upfront under the MoU.

threads.label: Hezbollah attacks in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: IDF reservist Master Sgt. Alexander Filin, 29, was killed and seven wounded by a Hezbollah explosive device in southern Lebanon, with five additional soldiers injured earlier by FPV drones near Kfar Tebnit and rocket fire on troops. Hezbollah's chief called the Iran deal a 'great victory' usable to expel Israel from Lebanon, with Times of Israel sources reporting expected Iranian cash injections post-deal.

threads.label: Iran economic reaction and oil
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran markets rallied on hopes of oil waivers and frozen-fund access, though economists warned relief would not cure structural weakness, while Jerusalem Post said Iranian tankers sidestepped the US Strait of Hormuz blockade in the past week. Trump told reporters US strategic oil reserves would have run out in roughly four weeks without the deal.

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and enforcement
threads.summary: The IDF announced the elimination of three Hamas operatives who infiltrated Israel on 7 October 2023, including sniper cell commander Ahmad Abu Hin and platoon commander Muhammad Sa'id Ahmad Nimrouti. Israeli authorities seized property linked to drone smuggling into Gaza in what was described as the first such financial-infrastructure enforcement action, and the DOJ charged a San Diego man with raising about $600K for Hamas via a fake Gaza charity.

threads.label: Iran nuclear and missile posture
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri said on Defa Press that enriched nuclear materials would not be transferred out of Iran and dilution inside the country was the only acceptable option. Iran International published an atlas mapping Iran's hidden missile bases, tunnels and shafts, while Araghchi briefed Cyprus's foreign minister by phone on the Islamabad MoU.
